product_summary: Radico Khaitan (Rampur Distillery, since 1943) is an IMFL distiller with a multi-category spirits portfolio confirmed on its own site: whisky (Rampur Indian Single Malt, Honey Whisky, Cinnamon Whisky, Magic Moments Whisky), vodka (Magic Moments Vodka, Magic Moments Remix flavoured vodka, Magic Moments Verve), gin (Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin), brandy (Morpheus Blue XO Premium Brandy), rum and flavoured rums, plus RTDs. The International page additionally states it is 'one of the largest Distillers of Ethyl Alcohol in Asia', producing Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA) from sugarcane molasses and grain, with facilities to export ethyl alcohol in HDPE barrels, IBCs and ISO tanks, and that it is one of India's oldest and largest malt distillers. Export presence claimed in 85+ countries, pack sizes 1.75L to 5cl.
comment: Declared 220830 (whisky) and 220850 (gin/genever) are both correct and corroborated by the site's own brand list: 220830 for Rampur single malt and the whisky range, 220850 for Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin. However the declaration covers only 2 of at least 6 spirit categories actually produced, so status is partial, not exact. Missing from the declaration: 220860 (vodka — Magic Moments, Remix, Verve, a flagship million-case brand), 220820 (spirits from grape wine / brandy — Morpheus Blue XO), 220840 (rum and flavoured rums), 220870 (liqueurs/RTDs, if the RTD range is spirit-based), 220890 (other spirituous beverages). Most significant omission: bulk ethyl alcohol / ENA, which belongs to 220710 (undenatured ethyl alcohol >=80% vol) and 220720 (denatured), and malt spirit — the company explicitly advertises export capability in ISO tanks and IBCs, i.e. a bulk B2B line entirely absent from the declared codes. If RTDs are malt- or wine-based rather than spirit-based, 220300 (beer) or 220600 could also apply; not determinable from the site. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: this is alcoholic beverages / distilling (HS chapter 22), not food-FMCG. No trader signs — own distilleries, own brands, own manufacturing; role is manufacturer. All product lines above are taken from the company's own website (radicokhaitan.com home page brand descriptions and /international/ page) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task, so no HS code here is corroborated by a shipment record. HS codes are my mapping of the stated products, not codes printed on any document.
